strap_vs_release_housing.min_mm: >= 21 (straps x -40..-8.5 vs housing front x -61.0 at zero pose; housing pivots, max zmax rise at knee 145 is +1.6 mm, front x shift not swept - FEA clearance step)

housing_plate_gap.why: the twin housing is trunnion-mounted and pivots with the screw angle: fin tops rise 1.6 mm from knee 0 to 145 (zmax 813.96 -> 815.52)
housing_plate_gap.fix: raise the L60 top plate + straps 4.0 mm (z 820-828): nominal 4.48 at knee 145, worst-case 4.48-0.72=3.76, RSS 4.15 (>= 3 both); cheeks +4 mm (L60 DZ precedent); ID rev 6 stack/shroud move up 4 mm
